mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS projectId, p.project_uuid AS projectUuid, p.name AS projectName, COUNT(ar.id) AS totalRunCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successRunCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ar.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedRunCount, MAX(ar.created_at) AS lastRunTime FROM game_project p LEFT JOIN agent_run ar ON p.id = ar.project_id AND ar.deleted = 0 WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.project_uuid, p.name ORDER BY lastRunTime DESC
